criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Find
categories.definition: User wants to locate a specific item or information.

categories.name: Play
categories.definition: User wants to listen to music, watch a movie, or play a specific content.

categories.name: Book
categories.definition: User wants to make a reservation or booking at a restaurant or other establishment.

categories.name: Add
categories.definition: User wants to add a specific item to a playlist or collection.

categories.name: Rate
categories.definition: User wants to provide a rating or review for a specific item.

categories.name: Show
categories.definition: User wants to see a schedule, forecast, or other information displayed.

categories.name: Search
categories.definition: User wants to search for a specific item or information.

categories.name: Forecast
categories.definition: User wants to know the weather forecast for a specific location and time.

categories.name: Watch
categories.definition: User wants to watch a specific TV show, movie, or trailer.

categories.name: Reserve
categories.definition: User wants to reserve a table or spot at a restaurant or other establishment.

categories.name: List
categories.definition: User wants to see a list of items or schedules.

categories.name: Insert
categories.definition: User wants to insert a specific item into a playlist or collection.
